text:
jamal_platform: Quick check — PR #4921 touches infra/serving/config and infra/serving/runtime. Not sure who can approve before tomorrow's release. Link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4921

alex_dev: From a CODEOWNERS perspective I think this falls under eng-platform + eng-runtime. Current CODEOWNERS snippet for that path looks like:

```
/infra/serving/ @eng-platform @eng-runtime
/infra/security/ @eng-security
```

maria_security: Heads up — the PR toggles the TLS default in the bootstrap config. I should do a quick security glance, would prefer to ack before merge.

ci-bot: quick-ci: lint failure in `infra/serving/bootstrap.py: line 42` — run `make lint` to see details.

jamal_platform: Ah, ok. Is there a formal override if owners are out? This is blocking tomorrow's 9am PT release window.

alex_dev: If eng-platform or eng-runtime approves, that satisfies CODEOWNERS. I'm around and can review/approve once lint fixed. I can also add a canary rollback policy in the PR to reduce risk.

lisa_pm: We really need this for the rollout feature. If it's not merged before 9am PT we'll have to delay the deploy. :grimacing:

alex_dev: I'll push a tiny lint fix in a follow-up commit in ~10m and request another CI run. @maria_security if you can do a quick look after that, we can merge.

maria_security: Will do — checking the TLS toggle now. If we change the default to `secure-by-default: true` we should also add a migration note.

jamal_platform: Migration note sounds good. Do we want an explicit security sign-off label? (e.g., `security/approved`)

maria_security: I'll add `security/approved` as a review comment once I confirm the migration note and a short test. Should be <30min.

deploy-bot: deploy-check: merge-window scheduled at 09:00 PT — last chance to merge is 08:45 PT.

ci-bot: quick-ci: all checks passing ✅ (lint fixed by alex_dev)

alex_dev: Approved as eng-platform :thumbsup: — leaving a note to monitor canary for 15m post-merge.

maria_security: security/approved — added migration note and small unit test for TLS toggle. :white_check_mark:

jamal_platform: Thanks everyone. Merging now and will watch the canary. If anything odd, I'll revert and notify #incidents.

alex_dev: Thanks — will stand by to help revert if needed.

lisa_pm: Amazing, thanks all! :tada:
